details: Bitcoin's price surged by 2.6% in the last 24 hours, reaching approximately $78,300 and briefly touching $80,000. This rally is attributed to easing oil prices following reports of a potential Iran-U.S. peace deal, which triggered significant short liquidations in the crypto market.
title: Bitcoin Rises as Oil Prices Ease on Iran Peace Hopes

details: Bloomberg analyst Mike McGlone cautioned crypto investors about a potential "unexpected decline" in Bitcoin. He highlighted that surging oil prices could fuel inflation and delay interest rate reductions by the Federal Reserve, leading to decreased market liquidity, which would negatively impact risky assets like Bitcoin.
title: Analyst Warns Bitcoin Vulnerable to Surging Oil & Liquidity Crunch

details: The U.S. economy's first-quarter growth fell short of expert forecasts, resulting in leading cryptocurrencies and traditional stocks largely moving sideways. Bitcoin traded within a narrow range, and the overall crypto market capitalization experienced a slight decrease, with derivatives traders showing a bearish sentiment.
title: US Q1 GDP Misses Forecasts, Crypto & Stocks Show Muted Response

details: The U.S. stock market saw a significant rally today, with the Nasdaq index leading the gains and closing at a new record high of 25,114.44. The S&P 500 also advanced, fueled by optimism for a swift resolution to the conflict involving Iran.
title: US Stock Market Rallies; Nasdaq Hits New Record Amid Iran Peace Hopes
